SCOPE OF SERVICE The Contractor shall provide enterprise -grade mobile and data services to the U.S. Embassy Panama. The prices listed below shall include all labor, service, equipment, technical support, materials, insurance (see FAR 52.228 -4 and 52.228- 5), overhead, and profit. The Government will pay the Contractor on a monthly basis for routine services that have been satisfactorily performed. The Contractor shall ensure that all services are delivered with high availability, reliability, and performance consistent with commercial best practices for enterprise telecommunications services. The Contractor shall offer two different plans to fulfill the Government needs: Basic Plan. Pay per use for actual calls (local, local long distance, international long distance), incoming and outgoing roaming calls, incoming and outgoing local SMS, incoming and outgoing international SMS, incoming and outgoing roaming SMS. Unlimited Smart Phones & Tablets Plan. A flat monthly rate per cellphone line that includes unlimited: local data, local minutes on-net, local minutes off-net, national long-distance minutes,

ta export of invoices in .csv or Excel format every month • Internet browsing for wireless handheld devices • Unassigned blank SIM cards for future issuance or replacement, and the ability to provision eSIM-enabled devices on demand • Wi-Fi Calling (Voice over Wi-Fi) • Unrestricted mobile hotspot (tethering) capability without additional charges, separate data allowances, or reduced speeds. • Cellular coverage with sufficient indoor signal strength to support reliable service throughout all office areas within the U.S. Embassy compound The Contractor shall ensure that services provided through its network are delivered with high availability, reliability, voice clarity, and data performance consistent with commercial best practices for enterprise telecommunications services. Mobile & Data Services 19PM0726Q0012 Page 10 of 11 The Contractor shall use commercially reasonable efforts to promptly identify, mitigate, and resolve network problems affecting Government services. The COR shall be informed as soon as reasonably possible of significant outages, degradations, and service restoration status. CALLS WITHIN PANAMA The Contractor shall pro

reliable international voice connectivity on a 24 -hour basis to the United States, Latin America, Europe, and other international destinations where commercially available telecommunications services exist. International calling services shall support clear and reliable voice communications consistent with the best commercial practices for enterprise telecommunications services. INTERNATIONAL ROAMING The Contractor shall provide broad international roaming coverage for voice, SMS, and data services through commercially established roaming agreements with foreign mobile network operators. Emphasis shall be placed on roaming availability and service reliability throughout the Western Hemisphere. The Contractor shall support international roaming services compatible with 4G/LTE services, and/or 5G services (5G services where commercially available). The Contractor shall provide the COR with an updated list of current international roaming partners and supported roaming countries at least every six (6) months. The Contractor shall disclose any significant roaming restrictions, unsupported regions, or service limitations in its proposal. SMS MESSAGING The Contractor shall provide reliable SMS messaging services on a 24- hour basis, including domestic, inter

ns and changes, lost or stolen device r eporting, billing inquiries, and service troubleshooting. The Contractor shall provide dedicated account management and support personnel who are fluent in both English and Spanish. The Contractor shall provide a dedicated customer support email address for the U.S. Embassy Panama. Mobile & Data Services 19PM0726Q0012 Page 12 of 13 In addition to email support, the Contractor shall provide 24/7 customer support through WhatsApp messaging and telephone support, with response times not exceeding one (1) hour for critical service issues.
